message.content:
Here are a few highly regarded sushi spots in Los Angeles that consistently receive rave reviews:

| Restaurant | Neighborhood | Highlights |
|------------|--------------|------------|
| **Sushi Gen** | Little Tokyo | Classic omakase, fresh fish, intimate setting |
| **KazuNori** | West Hollywood | Creative rolls, excellent service, great value |
| **Sushi Zo** | Beverly Hills | Omakase with a modern twist, meticulous presentation |
| **Matsuhisa** | Beverly Hills | Fusion of Japanese & Peruvian flavors, upscale vibe |
| **Sushi Park** | Koreatown | Fresh sashimi, friendly staff, reasonable prices |

If you’re looking for an unforgettable omakase experience, **Sushi Gen** or **Sushi Zo** are top picks. For a more casual yet high‑quality option, **KazuNori** offers creative rolls at a lower price point. Enjoy your meal!
